run_compute_overlap: run the script to compute pairwise overlap ratios for all point cloud NPZ files in a directory
run_make_open3d_point_cloud: run the script to create an Open3D point cloud from XYZ coordinates with optional voxel downsampling
run_compute_overlap_ratio: run the script to compute the overlap ratio between two Open3D point clouds using voxel-based matching
run_get_matching_indices: run the script to find matching point indices between a source point cloud and a KDTree within a search radius
review_compute_full_overlapping: review the script that loads NPZ point clouds, computes pairwise overlap, and writes results to overlap.txt
